title: Hostinger Review 2026: Pricing, Speed Test, AI Tools and Renewal Costs
excerpt: Hostinger starts at $1.99 a month and lists more AI tools than most cheap hosts. Here is what you pay after the sale, how fast it was in an independent test, and who should look elsewhere.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Hostinger Review 2026: Pricing, Speed Test, AI Tools
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Hostinger review for 2026: plan and renewal prices, a nine-day speed and uptime test from All About Cookies, AI tools, the Black Friday offer, pros and cons.
meta.rl_answer: Hostinger is a low-cost host with fast results in a named test and a long AI list. It needs a 48-month term for the sale price, and renewals cost more.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is Hostinger good? | All About Cookies reported 100% uptime over 9 days and a 138 ms average response time. It also noted that Hostinger is not PCI compliant and that renewals cost more.
How much does Hostinger cost? | Premium is $1.99 a month on a 48-month term and renews at $10.99 a month, according to Hostinger's own pages.
Is Hostinger good for WordPress? | In the All About Cookies test, a paid plan scored 99 out of 100 on page speed from three locations.
Is Hostinger legit? | Hostinger is an established host with a 30-day money-back guarantee listed. Read the term and renewal price before you buy.
Does Hostinger have AI features? | It lists an AI website builder, AI credits, an AI assistant called Hostinger Agent and an MCP server.
Is Hostinger good for an online store? | All About Cookies notes that Hostinger is not PCI compliant. If you take card payments on the site, check how your payment provider handles that.

meta.rl_takeaways:
Premium is $1.99 a month on a 48-month term and renews at $10.99.
All About Cookies measured 100% uptime over 9 days and a 138 ms average response.
Hostinger lists an AI builder, AI credits and an assistant called Hostinger Agent.
All About Cookies notes it is not PCI compliant.
meta.rl_r_verdict: Hostinger gives very low sale prices, fast results in an independent nine-day test and a long list of AI tools. The low price needs a 48-month term, and renewal costs about 5.5 times more.
meta.rl_r_buy:
You are starting a new site and can commit for four years.
You want AI tools such as a site builder and an assistant included.
You want a 30-day money-back window.
meta.rl_r_skip:
You want the lowest price on a short term.
You take card payments directly on the site, because Hostinger is not PCI compliant.
You need strong security tools.
meta.rl_r_pros:
Very low sale prices.
A 30-day money-back guarantee is listed.
Fast results and 100% uptime in a short independent test.
A wide set of AI tools is listed.
meta.rl_r_cons:
The sale price needs a 48-month term.
Renewal is about 5.5 times the sale price on Premium.
Not PCI compliant, and security is basic, according to All About Cookies.
